Vulnerable to *Bone Siphon* — the necromancer's default weapon ability that drains life from undead. The vines are animated by trapped souls; a successful Bone Siphon disrupts their necrotic tether.

Vulnerable to *Soul-Gas Cloud* — the lingering effect from the Soul-Bloom. The Stalkers are armored in hardened chitin that resists direct damage, but the soul-gas corrodes their joints, causing them to stagger and become open to critical strikes.

Vulnerable to *Soul-Infused Bone Shards* — the explosive, lingering cloud effect from the Bone Shards Core. The Sentinel is encased in a shield of petrified flesh and bone, impervious to all other attacks. Only the Soul-Gas Cloud from the Bone Shards Core can erode its shield over time.
